definitions.explanation: The main administrative center of an organization, company, or operation.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{本部|ほんぶ}は{東京|とうきょう}にある。
examples.english: The company's headquarters is in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}{対策|たいさく}{本部|ほんぶ}が{設置|せっち}された。
examples.english: A disaster response headquarters was established.

examples.japanese: {本部|ほんぶ}から{指示|しじ}が{来|き}た。

notes:
{本部|ほんぶ} refers to the central administrative location of an organization.

Common compounds:
- {本社|ほんしゃ} (head office - specifically for companies)
- {本店|ほんてん} (main store/branch)
- {対策|たいさく}{本部|ほんぶ} (response headquarters)
- {選挙|せんきょ}{対策|たいさく}{本部|ほんぶ} (election campaign headquarters)

Contrast:
- {本部|ほんぶ} - headquarters (general, can be temporary)
- {本社|ほんしゃ} - head office (specifically for corporations)
- {支部|しぶ}/{支店|してん} - branch (opposite of headquarters)
